spec.label: R-I084-1
spec.notes: Symptom: games 100 (16:10) and 200 (19:05), clock fixed at 15:29, run_single_check mocked (should_post False), the fallback refresh returns FallbackRefreshResult(daily, should_post=False), and check_confirmed_lineups reports every side confirmed. At the parent 0c8ed32, run_day computes has_pending_future_window BEFORE the sleep and the refresh, from the in-memory confirmed_sides that only run_single_check updates (empty here), so the 18:20 run for game 200 counts as a pending window; _should_defer_at_fallback(should_post=False, should_post_ungated=None, pending=True) defers, the pick is archived and removed, nothing is posted, and mock_post.assert_called_once() fails at line 1540. The 18:20 window could not finish before the 16:05 cutoff anyway. At F, the loop re-syncs confirmations for the remaining runs' games after the refresh, plan_fallback_action finds no pending window (legacy rule for an unknown block reason) and delivers. This is the flow of the parent's own deferral test (same schedule, clock and mocks; it asserted the archive and no post at the parent), so the red is the deferral decision, not a broken harness. Control: test_fallback_delivers_when_no_future_checks_remain (one game, no future run) delivers at both, showing mock_post is reachable on the parent's fallback path. EOD health checks run in both tests (no health_checks key); the health sources at 0c8ed32 make no network calls (subprocess git/systemctl only). Static checks at 0c8ed32: every patch target exists (fetch_schedule, _now_et, time, run_single_check, run_result_polling, _trigger_live_forward_capture_on_lock, _refresh_pick_at_fallback_decision, check_confirmed_lineups, retry_urlopen; bts.posting.post_to_bluesky; bts.picks.get_game_statuses_detailed); FallbackRefreshResult(daily, should_post) is valid there. The anchor text occurs on lines 1219, 1304, 1540 and 1603 of tests/test_scheduler.py at 3697512; line 1540 is inside the symptom test.
